scope: Static regression coverage for the report verifier's helper and rollback identity comparisons on root PASS reports.
limitations: The verifier compares values reported by the report; this regression does not independently inspect or hash the final packaged helper or rollback binary.
Signature status remains an evidence claim; the checker does not cryptographically verify Authenticode signatures.
The task remains gated on T04 acceptance, controlled release behavior, package lifecycle and rollback evidence, and an independent critical review.
